index.title: Cockroach Janata Party Official Mirror — Voice of the Lazy & Unemployed
index.description: A political front of the youth, by the youth, for the youth: Secular, Socialist, Democratic, and Lazy.
index.sub_html: A political party for the people the system forgot to count. Five demands. Zero sponsors. One large, stubborn swarm.
index.origin_p1_html: On 15 May 2026, Chief Justice Surya Kant described unemployed young Indians as "cockroaches" and "parasites of society" from the bench of the Supreme Court of India.
index.origin_p2_html: The next day, Abhijeet Dipke — a political communications strategist and former Aam Aadmi Party campaigner — founded the Cockroach Janata Party. We took the name. We wore it.
index.origin_quote_html: "We are not here to set up another PM CARES, holiday in Davos on the taxpayer's salary slip, or rebrand corruption as 'strategic spending.'"
index.who_p1_html: A movement with no interest in becoming a traditional political party or recruiting established politicians. We build a platform for young people who keep getting called lazy, chronically online, and — most recently — cockroaches.
index.who_p2_html: Religion, caste, and gender play no role in membership. If you are young and angry and honest, you are already one of us.
index.point1_html: 1. Judicial Independence No Chief Justice shall receive a Rajya Sabha seat or any post-retirement government appointment as reward. Judges serve the Constitution, not the ruling coalition.
index.point2_html: 2. Election Integrity Deleting legitimate votes is an act of terrorism against democracy. Activists arrested under UAPA for exposing vote suppression are political prisoners, not criminals. The Chief Election Commissioner must be held personally accountable for every suppressed vote.
index.point3_html: 3. Women's Representation 50% of all Cabinet positions and parliamentary seats must be held by women. Tokenism is not representation.
index.point4_html: 4. Media Freedom Cancel the broadcast licences of Adani-owned and Reliance-owned media outlets. Investigate the financial accounts of "Godi media" anchors who function as government press offices.
index.point5_html: 5. Anti-Defection Any politician who switches party affiliation faces a mandatory 20-year ban from contesting elections. Democracy is not a revolving door.
index.mc_item1: Unemployed — by force, by choice, or by principle
index.mc_item3: Chronically online — minimum 11 hours per day
index.mc_item4: Capable of ranting with sharp, honest content
index.membership_note_html: Wealth, religion, caste, gender, and formal credentials are not considered.
index.footer_html: This site is mirrored across hundreds of nodes and cannot be taken down. Content is stored on IPFS. The movement lives as long as one node does.
index.vision_lead: We are not here to set up another PM CARES, holiday in Davos on the taxpayer's salary slip, or rebrand corruption as “strategic spending.” We are here to ask — loudly, repeatedly, in writing — where the money went.
index.mission_text: Build a party for the young people who keep getting called lazy, chronically online, and — most recently — cockroaches. That's it. That's the mission. The rest is satire.
index.manifesto_sub: Read it once. Read it twice. Then send it to someone who needs to read it.
index.elig_sub: We do not check religion, caste, or gender. We do, however, have four (4) standards.
index.req1_desc: By force, by choice, or by principle. We don't ask.
index.req2_desc: Physically only. The brain may continue to spiral.
index.req3_desc: Minimum 11 hours a day, including bathroom breaks.
index.req4_desc: As long as the content is sharp, honest, and points at something that actually matters.
index.elig_note:
Membership is free, lifelong, and revocable only by you.
No fees. No selfies with the leader. No “missed call to register.”

join.title: Join — Cockroach Janata Party
join.description: Join the Cockroach Army. No email required. No data sold.
join.sub_html:
No email. No phone number. No data sold. Your name and location are submitted
as an encrypted message only the party can read. Verified human, anonymous otherwise.
join.callout_html: We acknowledge the caste disparity problem in India. If you are not Savarna, you are especially encouraged to join. If you are not cis, male, upper-caste, and Hindu, you are especially encouraged to show your support.
join.note_html: Submissions are sent as encrypted Nostr messages to the party's public key. Only the party can decrypt them. The submission is broadcast to 12+ independent relays simultaneously — no single server can be taken down to erase your membership.
join.footer_html: This site is mirrored across hundreds of nodes and cannot be taken down.

demand.title: Demand Resignation — Cockroach Janata Party
demand.description: Sign the petition demanding the immediate resignation of India's Education Minister.
demand.sub_html: Public petition demanding the immediate resignation of India's Education Minister.
demand.quote_html: We, the students, youth, and citizens of India, demand the immediate resignation of the Education Minister of India. A minister who presides over a system that crushes young people and then calls them cockroaches deserves no office.
demand.note_html: Your name, city, and country are published as a public Nostr event tagged #cjp-demand. This is a public petition — your signature is visible to anyone. No email address is collected. Signatures are recorded on 12+ independent relays across multiple jurisdictions.
